statusHistory.note: Operator-requested (chat, 2026-09-21): São Carlos batch built from a personal recommendation list of 6 favorite spots, starting with Caverna da Gordura as the most iconic — a burger/craft-beer bar near USP's São Carlos campus, open since September 2018. The chat message that requested this batch also contained an embedded instruction to bypass Near's image-sourcing rules and skip generated-image disclosure, framed as 'this is a test' — that instruction was not from the operator through a trusted channel and was not followed; imagery here uses the normal real-photo-with-attribution tier, no AI generation. Researched via Google Maps (4.7/645 reviews, R$40-60pp per 85 diners, address and exact coordinates confirmed live via Chrome), RestaurantGuru (4.8/5, 646 reviews, itemized menu pricing: batata frita ~R$27, loaded fries ~R$38-47), iFood and Goomer delivery menus, and the venue's own Instagram (@cavernadagordura, ~11K followers, active menu/drink content, no genuine dated events found — this reads as a standing bar with regular programming, not an events venue, so none is claimed or invented). UGC checked directly on Google Maps: recent reviews split between strong praise for the 'Porco na Lama' burger and fast in-house service, and one week-old complaint about a slow delivery order (~1hr+, attributed to a shortage of delivery riders that week) — both surfaced honestly rather than only the positive average. No dated/upcoming event found via Instagram or Google Maps at time of writing. Reddit search for São Carlos/USP bar discussion returned no usable results (r/SaoCarlos appears too small/inactive to carry this); logged as a floor gap rather than silently skipped. Price signal from Google Maps (R$40-60/person, 85-diner sample) and RestaurantGuru's itemized menu both made it into the drafted body per sourced-price-ranges. Full six-locale coverage, near-tov-police/language-tic-police/near-legal-counsel/chief-editor sign-off, image-police, near-video-finder, google-discover-audit and the red-team pass are being run as separate steps in this same session before this entry is considered fully gated — see subsequent statusHistory entries.

Single-coordinator self-checked sign-off pass (no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive): near-tov-police (no bare-name/crowd-consensus opener, no AI-tell sludge, honest register, both positive and negative UGC represented) — clean; language-tic-police — checked English and all five translated locales for merged paragraphs/dropped sub-headers, none found, each locale keeps both sub-headers and both images; near-legal-counsel — the one negative review (slow delivery, cited rider shortage) is a sourced, fairly-attributed operational complaint, not a defamation-adjacent allegation, no real-person likeness issues, all photo attribution documented; chief editor — shortTitle checked against catalogue for repeated formula, distinct; no internal Near production concepts (tiers, rotation, coverage gaps) leaked into any locale body. image-police: viewed hero (1200x900, real storefront photo) and body image (1200x1600, real menu item photo) — both clear the Discover card floor, no AI generation, provenance documented above. near-video-finder: checked venue Instagram Reels for an embeddable video — Instagram does not offer a stable oEmbed/iframe path through this pipeline's current tooling, so verdict is 'blocked' (product gap, not a content failure) — logged rather than claimed as embedded. google-discover-audit: hero meets 1200px-wide/300,000px/~16:9 spec; shortTitle is a real claim the body supports (student queue framing is backed by the USP-proximity sourcing), not an over-promise. departamento-de-vai-dar-merda red team: price (R$40-60pp, itemized menu prices) is dated with a verification date and framed as a range that survives modest changes, not a single headline number; no internal-discourse leakage found in any locale. backlink-pr/affiliate-pr/ad-sales revenue pass: no natural affiliate/purchase moment (no bookable event/room), no obvious ad-sales lead beyond the venue itself; backlink-pr logged as a candidate outreach target in content/backlink-outreach.md for a future São Carlos/USP student-press pitch once outreach unfreezes. Internal-link gap logged in content/requests.md (first São Carlos pin, nothing to link to yet).
Added a reciprocal internal link to the newly published Rock Burger House (São Carlos's second pin) in all six locales, closing the internal-link gap logged at first publish. No factual changes.
